echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: Tailor-made for her: 20% Crit Rate on inflicting Spectro Frazzle plus Spectro DMG Bonus scaling with Frazzle stacks. Nightmare: Mourning Aix boosts Spectro DMG by 12% and deals more damage to Frazzle-affected enemies. Conflict: Game8's Aug 2026 update now recommends Capitaneus as the main Echo instead.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Viable placeholder before Eternal Radiance is farmed; offers general Spectro DMG but lacks the Frazzle buffs.

build.energy_regen_target: 125-130% via substats (110-120% acceptable for Absolution DPS per some sources)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Luminous Hymn (signature; Stringmaster or Cosmic Ripples otherwise) + 5-piece Eternal Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Go Crit Rate/DMG on the 4-cost, Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs, ATK% on both 1-costs, and aim for ~125% Energy Regen via substats. Her damage collapses without Spectro Frazzle on the target, so always pair her with a Frazzle applier like Spectro Rover or Zani.

ranked_weapons.name: Luminous Hymn
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit Rate substat, ATK plus Basic/Heavy Attack DMG against Frazzle-affected enemies, and her Outro amplifies Spectro Frazzle damage by 30% for 30s.

ranked_weapons.name: Stringmaster
ranked_weapons.note: Yinlin's weapon; best 5-star alternative. Big Crit Rate plus all-attribute DMG and ATK buffs that Phoebe uses extremely well.

ranked_weapons.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
ranked_weapons.note: Zhezhi's signature; ranked #3 across multiple build guides as a strong general 5-star stat stick for Phoebe.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner and therefore accessible. ATK% substat with a Basic Attack DMG bonus and some Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Ocean's Gift
ranked_weapons.note: Event-exclusive 4-star; stacks Spectro DMG bonus when damaging Frazzle-affected enemies, tailored to her mechanic.

ranked_weapons.name: Augment
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's recommended 4-star alternative; accessible rectifier when no 5-star is available.

stat_priorities.note: Balance the Crit ratio; Eternal Radiance already grants 20% Crit Rate on Frazzle infliction.
Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs for her main-DPS role.

profile.role_note: Dual Confession (Sub-DPS)/Absolution (DPS) states; premier Spectro Frazzle applicator and Zani's best partner. Personal damage is notable in Absolution state.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Available via the 3.7 Moonlit Path spending selector (980 Moonlit Rings, Sep 30-Nov 11 2026; choose Shorekeeper, Carlotta, or Phoebe). Pick her only if you are building around Spectro Frazzle - she is Zani's best partner and enables the archetype. Otherwise she sits at A-tier and outside the current meta; most accounts get far more from Shorekeeper in this selector.

members.name: Zani
members.note: The burst carry; detonates stacked Spectro Frazzle with her Redundant Energy mechanics.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Confession-state Frazzle applicator; amplifies Frazzle so Zani can explode it.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing; fits the full-Spectro resonance.

teams.name: Premium: Zani + Phoebe + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Phoebe holds her Resonance Skill to enter Confession and stack/amplify Spectro Frazzle; Zani builds Redundant Energy and detonates the Frazzle stacks for the main damage window; Shorekeeper keeps Stellarealm deployed for Crit buffs and sustain.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Absolution-state on-field DPS; needs Frazzle on the target at all times.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: The Frazzle applier Phoebe is built around; near-non-negotiable teammate.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Sustain and universal Crit buffs with barely any field time.

teams.name: Alternative: Phoebe + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Spectro Rover opens to apply Spectro Frazzle; Phoebe enters Absolution and takes the on-field window with Heavy-attack combos; Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and detonates it before outroing back to Rover. Never continue the rotation if Frazzle is not applied - Phoebe's damage collapses without it.

tier_badge.label: A-Tier
tier_badge.note: A-tier in Beebom's Oct 2026 (Version 3.7) and MMO Culture's Sep 2026 (Version 3.6) tier lists. Launch-era lists had her S; the current meta no longer revolves around Spectro Frazzle, but she remains Zani's best partner.

sequences.verdict: S0 is an excellent baseline. Go weapon before S1, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Excellent baseline — top-tier Spectro DPS/sub-DPS at S0.
Must-pull burst button; enables the Confession burst.
S0 to S3 is +64% DPS — the optimal stopping point.
Luxury CC and damage; whale territory.
